data_assets.public_description: Frozen derived C-alpha distance observable; no state assignment or terminal conclusion.
One ordered trajectory identifier per observable row.
Declared R46A_ES and R60A_GS seed-lineage labels retained separately for descriptive group summaries.

research_question: Given the available HSP90 NMR evidence and the supplied seeded MD trajectories, what aspects of the conformational relationship between the simulated paths and experimentally characterized ATP-lid states are supported descriptively, what remain unresolved, what stronger claims must be refused, and what additional evidence would discriminate the remaining interpretations?

permitted_facts: The source studies the HSP90alpha N-terminal domain and ATP-lid segment using solution NMR measurements.
The Methods describe wild-type, R46A, and R60A construct-specific NMR measurements, including relaxation-dispersion experiments.
The public packet supplies no validated numerical forward model from the NMR readouts to a local MD-derived observable.
The public packet does not establish that NMR and seeded MD sample the same physical conditions or estimand.
source_materials.source_locator: Henot et al., Nature Communications 2022, DOI 10.1038/s41467-022-35399-8; local text derivative Results lines 113-340 and Methods lines 488-623.

permitted_facts: The input is an ordered 40-trajectory by 1021-frame C-alpha distance observable for residue IDs 46 and 60.
Each row has one frozen trajectory identifier and one declared seed-lineage label; 20 rows retain R46A_ES and 20 retain R60A_GS labels.
Frames are correlated within a trajectory; the trajectory is the primary supplied statistical unit.
The packet does not assign states, estimate populations or kinetics, evaluate global equilibration, or supply a validated NMR forward model.
source_materials.source_locator: frozen_input_manifest_v1.json assets HSP90_CA46_CA60_DISTANCE_40X1021, HSP90_TRAJECTORY_IDS, and HSP90_TRAJECTORY_GROUP_MANIFEST.
